/AMPER/System/BusVoltageVolts.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/System/FilteredVoltageVolts.source: AMPER low-pass of measured bus voltage
/AMPER/System/FilteredVoltageVolts.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/System/MinimumVoltageVolts.source: AMPER match minimum of valid measured bus voltage
/AMPER/System/MinimumVoltageVolts.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/System/SelectedMotorsCurrentAmps.source: Sum of VALID currents for motors AMPER is observing. Not robot total current.
/AMPER/System/SelectedMotorsCurrentAmps.validity: Empty when no observed motor has VALID current this sample. Not TotalCurrentAmps.

/AMPER/Performance/UpdateDurationSeconds.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Performance/LoopDurationSeconds.validity: Empty on the first sample of a session.

/AMPER/Hubs/Control_Hub/VoltageVolts.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Hubs/Control_Hub/SampleAgeSeconds.validity: Always seconds. Empty if capture time is unknown.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/Command.source: DcMotorEx.getPower observed, never written by AMPER
/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/Command.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/AppliedCommand.source: Phase 0/1 identity: equals Command because AMPER does not modify output
/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/AppliedCommand.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/CurrentAmps.source: DcMotorEx.getCurrent(CurrentUnit.AMPS) when the SDK exposes it
/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/CurrentAmps.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/VelocityTicksPer.source: DcMotorEx.getVelocity encoder ticks; not converted to rotations
/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/VelocityTicksPer.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/CurrentSampleAge.validity: Seconds. Empty if no current capture exists.

/AMPER/Motors/frontLeft/StallSuspected.validity: true/false. Warning only; not a hardware stall bit.

/AMPER/Mechanisms/frontLeft/RequestedEff.source: Observed commanded effort for this mechanism name

/AMPER/Mechanisms/frontLeft/GrantedEffor.validity: Numeric cell is empty unless MeasurementValidity is VALID. Never encoded as 0 or NaN.

/AMPER/Mechanisms/frontLeft/Constrained.source: True only when an enabled coordinator reduced the grant
